name: Chigasaki Mamoru
source:
[i]"You look pale. Don't push yourself. Just focus on yourself first, okay?"[/i]

A soft spoken and respectful man. Whenever the protagonist is in trouble, he lends her a hand. He tries to avoid any conflict and is a very peaceful person. He loves to collect succulents. 

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/chara/?page=ch3]Idea Factory International[/url]]
